facts.fact: Hattie 合上笔记本电脑，手的触感已不像自己的。
facts.anchor: Hattie closes the laptop with a hand that doesn’t feel like her own.

facts.fact: Hattie 想象 Colm 与母亲无生命的尸体共处漫长时间，可能击垮了他的一部分心智。
facts.anchor: She imagines the long hours and endless days Colm spent with his mother’s lifeless body.

facts.fact: Hattie 触摸纸上 Leah、Dustin、Colm 三人的名字，意识到这份名单已成嫌疑人名单。
facts.anchor: Hattie touches Leah’s, Dustin’s, and Colm’s names on the paper

facts.fact: 走廊传来声音，旧 iPhone 响起。
Hattie 冲回房间拉开床头柜，以为是 Tommy 打来求助，却是 Leah。
facts.anchor: Hattie hurries to her room and pulls open the bedside drawer, sure it will be Tommy calling

facts.fact: Leah 问那个作家是不是在场，Hattie 隐瞒真相回答说他走了。
facts.anchor: No. No, he’s not here. He’s—” Something keeps her from telling Leah the truth. Not yet, not yet. “He’s gone.

facts.anchor: So, the other reason I’m calling is Thanksgiving.

facts.fact: Hattie 放下拒绝的念头，答应前来团聚。
